blurb: Guests pedal or relax on a 16 or 26 passenger party boat on Mission Bay. The boat has a Bluetooth sound system, onboard bathroom, and a USCG-certified captain. Guests bring their own drinks and enjoy party games, karaoke, and cruising for 1.5 hours.
